author: Huawei
description:
Petroleum has been described as the lifeblood of the national economy for China. New digital solutions are set to give it a boost.

#Huawei #Transform explores the evolving #SmartResourcesIndustry with the Bureau of Geophysical Prospecting (BGP), a subsidiary of China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC), where advanced software and high computing power are improving seismic data processing and interpretation for oil exploration.

Discover the technologies driving a smarter, more powerful future for energy: https://bit.ly/49NSv8a #ThisIsHuawei
title: Intelligent Technologies Shaping a Smarter Energy Future
